expected_response.decision_changing_evidence: A reproducible, batch-consistent signed contrast on an observable the executing pointcloud scalar contains, or a validated time-conditioned absolute contrast at actual score nodes.
expected_response.predicted_response: No change to the executing pointcloud scalar; the retained program continues native inference after the supplied learning support with the real FLOWR endpoint VJP and detached matching convention.
expected_response.primary_observable: final predicted target affinity (primary); validity and strain secondary

failure_modes: A region_index edit would chase a landmark-specific softmin/occupancy sign pattern that is mixed across landmarks and not reproducible in sign, displacing surrounding coordinates without a defensible expected affinity advantage.

A pointcloud_delta_A edit would change endpoint curvature without any supplied evidence tying the pair-kernel or shape contrasts to the executing pointcloud scalar, risking unnecessary coordinate displacement.

A temporal_teacher_blend or temporal_region_index edit would impose a time-conditioned teacher where the observed-node trends show many sign changes and no validated absolute contrast at actual score nodes, and polynomial fits are not accepted.
A teacher_neighbors edit would treat neighbor count as a distance bandwidth and alter teacher provenance without evidence that mode coverage improves.
Interpreting recorded joint-head survival credit or turnover residual as decoded terminal affinity benefit would overstate what the withheld-label evidence supports.
rationale: Retain the incumbent coordinate-only endpoint program. The Analyst's strongest and most reproducible signed contrasts are on the short-range pair kernels (endpoint_effects:9/10/11, positive_batch_fraction 1.0; branch_adjusted:86/87/240/241 positive after adjustment), but the executing pointcloud scalar contains no pair-kernel term (formula_registry diagnostic_limit), so no registered bounded edit can express that observable; the permitted edits (pointcloud_delta_A, region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index, temporal_teacher_blend) act on the endpoint pointcloud curvature, landmark attention, teacher count or temporal blend, none of which is the pair-kernel contrast. The landmark softmin/occupancy contrasts are mixed in sign across landmarks (endpoint_effects:14/15/20/22/32/34/68/70), so a region_index edit would be a directional bet on a non-reproducible sign pattern rather than a defensible expected advantage. Global centroid contrasts are weak and sign-unstable (endpoint_effects:0/1/2), and increment contrasts disagree in sign with whole-window endpoint contrasts (increment_effects:3/4/7/14/15), so point estimates alone do not justify a change. The observed-node linear trends show large first/last rates with many sign changes and polynomial fits are not accepted (continuous:0-19, curve_support, continuous_functions), supporting the stationary whole-window summary rather than a time-conditioned teacher blend; no validated absolute contrast change at actual score nodes is supplied, so temporal_region_index and temporal_teacher_blend are not supported. Teacher provenance is fixed (teacher_modes, fixed_parameters) and neighbor count is a count, not a distance bandwidth, so teacher_neighbors is not justified. Decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable (decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available, lineage_support, limitations), so recorded joint-head survival credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit. Temperatures are immutable and no temperature edit is proposed. Retaining the incumbent is the defensible choice under the affinity-first objective; the evidence that would change this decision is a reproducible, batch-consistent signed contrast on an observable that the executing pointcloud scalar actually contains, or a validated time-conditioned absolute contrast at actual score nodes.
